config:
[backend]
kind = "metal"

[backend.metal]
graph_replay = "tier2"

[bench]
breakdown = false
contexts = [9, 512, 2048, 4000]
decode_prefill = 8
pp = 512
reps = 5
selection = ["gpu-sequential", "gpu-pipelined"]
tg = 128
warmups = 1

[bench.sampling]
seed = 0
temperature = 0.0
top_k = 0
top_p = 1.0

[bench.vary]
"bench.pp" = [37, 512, 700, 1500, 2048, 4000]

[limits]
dispatches_per_list = 4096
gpu_time_budget = "3600000ms"
guest_call_timeout = "300000ms"
guest_memory_bytes = 4294967296
instances = 10000
live_bytes = 51539607552
live_graphs = 16
live_kernels = 64
live_tensor_handles = 20000
read_bytes = 1073741824
submission_timeout = "60000ms"
table_elements = 10000
tensor_elements = 1000000000
tensor_rank = 4
work_per_dispatch = "unlimited"

[run]
max_tokens = 128
temperature = 0.0
top_k = 0
top_p = 1.0

[verify]
prompts = []
